page.overview:
Who is Johnny and Jamie?

"When Johnny and Jamie were young they spent more time goofing off at the race than watching it. They've matured a lot since then and now know that it's silly to waste race time playing pranks and getting into trouble. That's why they now show up early to play pranks and get into trouble."

Johnny and Jamie attend the final Piston Cup race at the Los Angeles International Speedway. They are seen drooling from the side of the circuit.
